messages.subject: [Viennar-meetup] Vienna - R 2019 March
messages.body_plain:
I am happy to announce the meetup for March.
https://www.meetup.com/ViennaR/events/259235903/

There will be two presentations by Laura Vana and
Hadley Wickham.
Laura Vana will talk about the R-Ladies and there will be a talk by Hadley
Wickham and a Q&A session and there will be wine and beer afterwards. Since
I am not involved <https://www.dict.cc/englisch-deutsch/involved.html> in
the planning of this R-Meetup this are all the informations I have so far.

The Meetup will take place
on Monday, March 18, 2019
from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM
at Webster Vienna Private University - Praterstra?e 23, 1020 Wien

Best,
Florian
